verdict.rationale: Superset documents scheduled automations whose output lands in a live workspace you can open and review. Each run sits on its own Git worktree and branch, reviewed in a diff viewer and integrated through ordinary PRs, so unwanted results can be dropped by not merging. Automations can also be managed from code via the SDK, CLI and MCP, which implies definitions could be kept in source control. Missing for 10: native versioning of automation definitions, documented review or approval of automation changes, explicit rollback to a prior automation version, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
